method: Analytic saved-vector pool growth, parameter/profile compatibility, lineage, selected-cluster promotion and membership-only publication/reversal tests

fixture.recipe: Full SHA-256-shaped synthetic content IDs with vectors (1,0), (0,1), (-1,0), missing vectors; DBSCAN eps .15/.16/1.1; 9/10/11-image seed boundaries; every disposition
fixture.saved_payload: tests/test_album_vectors.py: real float16 [3,4] NPY, digest/order/profile ledger, explicit full image/crop manifest
fixture.confusables_scope: Analytic boundary/conflict scenarios only; no separately consented held-out ALBUM-CONFUSABLE-v1 corpus executed

comparator: Default pool contains only hypothesis/deferred/unknown-foreign/pending unresolved targets; missing vectors retained
Wrong crop binding rejected; changed semantic profile quotes re-embedding-required members and blocks clustering
Growth and parameter changes produce new frozen snapshots; parent overlap and committed memberships preserve lineage
Representative wall reuses existing full-hash tie-breaking algorithm with twelve-image cap
Seed eligibility counts distinct images with default threshold ten; smaller selected promotion refused
One selected cluster among multiple seeds promotes in one batch; unrelated cluster/noise/missing-vector rows unchanged
Membership-only re-clustering and promotion undo restore exact eligible before-state; notes survive
limitations: No held-out identity/coherence or precision qualification; coherent_wall is measurement, not verification
Cost is an arithmetic pair-comparison bound and explicit re-embedding count, not measured time or price
No scheduled discovery or enabled client flow; CLI/local backend only
LSP unavailable: basedpyright not installed, prior installation decline respected
Existing G5 authority enrollment, memory/support cascades and physical-power-loss gates remain open
